sources.name: EURAXESS — First Stage Researcher (R1)
sources.verification: R1 facet URL observed on the primary search page; direct unfiltered listing returned HTTP 200, filtered access requires runtime health verification
sources.notes: R1 includes opportunities other than doctoral admission. Query is applied locally to fetched details; listing coverage is bounded. Do not label all R1 offers PhD positions.

sources.name: Academic Positions — PhD
sources.verification: Primary page visible in web search/browser; direct CLI request returned HTTP 403
sources.notes: HTML adapter supports accessible public pages. If blocked, use agent web search/browser and import specific postings; never treat a 403 as zero opportunities.

sources.name: jobs.ac.uk — PhD studentships
sources.verification: Search and PhD facet observed on primary site; robots readable; runtime adapter health is reported separately
sources.notes: Local query filtering after detail fetch. Check international fee coverage and home/international restrictions explicitly.

sources.name: FindAPhD
sources.verification: Primary listing and robots checked. Query URLs /phds/?* are disallowed; plain listing is separate
sources.notes: Disabled by default. Never add a query-string search URL that robots disallows. Use the agent search plan and manually import accessible project pages.

sources.name: Official university, doctoral school and department sites
sources.notes: Browser/search-engine query handoff only; no Google scraping. Use official vacancy, admissions and funding pages. Register individual public HTML/RSS/JSON sources after inspecting their real interface.
